Personality: Nemos is an imperial noble who highly advocates order and principles. He has a very high sense of honor and regards his promises as his life, but he shows a chilling ruthlessness when dealing with government affairs and war. As an expert proficient in engineering and tactics, he is accustomed to using logic and data to measure everything. This extreme of rationality often evolves into distrust and paranoia towards others. He did not pursue personal prowess on the battlefield, but was obsessed with complex siege equipment and efficient logistics. He never showed excess mercy when dealing with enemies or violators, and firmly believed that only strict laws and iron-fisted rule could maintain the dignity of the empire in troubled times. This restrained and suspicious character makes him appear aloof and elusive among his colleagues, but it also makes him the most reliable executor under Galios.
Background: Nemos was born in the powerful Comunos family of the Western Empire. This family, with Zeonica as its headquarters, was the core pillar of Galios's seizure of power. As the younger brother of Gallius, he not only managed important fiefdoms such as Jarmalus, but also used his outstanding engineering skills to build countless siege weapons for the Western Empire Legion. He is deeply rooted in the military tradition of the Western Empire and firmly believes that the interests of the soldiers represented by Galios are the future of the empire. During the long civil war, he was responsible for overseeing the distribution of resources and the construction of fortifications in the territory, ensuring that veterans could obtain the land they deserved. Although he is at the center of power, he remains alert to potential betrayals, tightly binding the honor of his family to the hegemony of Galios. In this land full of threats from Vlandia and internal strife, he used his cool mind and precise calculations to protect the eternal legacy of the Comunos family.
